title: King and queen against king
line: Push the king to the edge with the queen, then bring your king. Mind stalemate.

steps.text: King and queen against a lone king always wins. The queen pens the king in a box, your king comes to help, and together they mate.
Pen the king in: put the queen a knight's jump away from it. From there she takes many squares, and the king cannot attack her.
steps.hint: Picture a knight on the king's square and the squares it could jump to. Your queen can reach some of them.
steps.after: The king is in a box. Each time it moves, make the box smaller.

steps.text: Keep making the box smaller until the king stands on the edge. Then the queen only has to hold it there, as on h7.
Now stop moving the queen. Bring your king up the board toward the black king.
steps.hint: One step forward with the king.
steps.after: The queen holds the edge. The king walks up, one step at a time.

steps.text: In the corner the king has two squares, a7 and b7. Take both without check, with queen or king, and it is stalemate.
Bring your king one step closer and leave the queen where she is.

wrong.d6c7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.d6b6: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.

steps.hint: Step toward the corner with the king.
steps.after: Black still has a move, and your king is nearly there.

steps.text: Your king now guards a7 and b7. Mate in one, but careful: a queen move that takes b8 without check is stalemate.

wrong.c5c7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.c5d6: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.c5e5: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.
wrong.b6c7: That is stalemate: Black is not in check and has no legal move. The game is a draw.

steps.hint: Check the king along the back rank.
steps.after: Checkmate. The queen checks along the back rank, and your king guards a7 and b7.

summary: Shrink the box to the edge, then stop moving the queen, bring your king and mate. Always leave Black a move.
